messages:
lina: Heads up team  proposing a 'latency-first' region selection flow for hosted API. Goals: pick lowest-latency region that meets tenant SLOs, fall back by model variant only when allowed, and make all decisions visible in console/telemetry.

samir: UX suggestion  two toggles on tenant settings: "Prefer lowest-latency region" and "Allow model-variant fallback". Default for new customers = enabled/disabled respectively. Also expose a "sticky pin" so customers can lock to one region.

rebecca: Telemetry quick note: add metrics `routing.latency.p95_by_region`, `routing.p99_by_region`, `routing.fallbacks.count`, and `routing.decision.duration_ms`. We need sample windows: 30s for fast sensitivity, and 5m for stability. Without both, we get oscillation.

nikhil: rough policy sketch (YAML):

```
policy:
  selection: latency
  sample_windows:
    fast: 30s
    stable: 5m
  tiers:
    enterprise:
      p95_ms: 120
      allow_variant_fallback: false
      sticky_pin: true
    pro:
      p95_ms: 200
      allow_variant_fallback: true
      sticky_pin: false
  fallback_sequence:
    - model: main_fp32
    - model: q4_compat
    - model: tiny-lowlat
  max_fallback_depth: 2
  headers:
    hint: x-region-preference
    expose: x-selected-region
```

lina: Important: how do quotas interact? If region A is saturated and tenant is pinned, do we throttle, queue, or offload to region B (breaking pin)?

samir: Policy options: (A) respect pin and throttle w/ 429 + `REGION_PINNED` code; (B) allow emergency offload if tenant opts into "pin override on saturation". Need clear console messaging.

rebecca: Also add `quota.bailout_count` metric when we attempt to failover due to quota. Console should show a one-click CTA: "Request dedicated capacity" when bailout_rate > 0.5%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: geo-routing/v2 rolled to staging; flagged to 5% internal traffic.

nikhil: Dev ops alerts proposal: alert if (fallbacks.count > 0.5% for enterprise over 1h) OR (region_utilization > 80% for >10m). Also track `variant_quality_regressions` from E2E evals and link to tenant dashboards.

lina: API compatibility: if no routing object present, default to legacy customer-region affinity. Add `routing` object shape to API v2 with graceful fallback for older SDKs. We'll publish migration guide.

samir: Add client guidance: clients can set `x-region-preference: latency|cost|region` to influence routing when permitted. If server returns 429 `REGION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED`, include `x-selected-region` header to help clients surface fallback UI.

rebecca: Rollout plan: behind FF `geo-routing-v2`. Phase 1: internal tenants only (2 days). Phase 2: 1% public traffic (1 week). Phase 3: 20% with monitoring gates (2 weeks). Gate checks: no enterprise fallback >0.1%, stable p95 delta <10% vs baseline.

nikhil: I'll add tracing spans `routing.decision` and tags `routing.selection`, `routing.depth`, `routing.variant` so we can reconstruct decision paths end-to-end.

lina: Nice. Can someone open an RFC and attach this thread + decision matrix? Also add a short migration checklist for Dedicated/Private customers (how pinning maps to private topology).

samir: I'll mock the tenant settings modal and the console banner text. Posting visuals to #design by EOD.

rebecca: One more edge-case: simultaneous cross-region overloads. Policy: after exhausting fallback depth, return 429 with `REGION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED` and a human-friendly message. We'll include a `retry_after_ms` field in the response body.

lina: Great. Opening RFC now and will include the YAML, metrics list, and rollout plan. Thanks all :rocket:
